title: Wither Tools
body:
Craft a block that Wither cannot destroy, either with initial explosion, or blue skulls.
![Wither prison](https://i.imgur.com/6VlpRKT.png)

Recommended minimum inner dimensions: 3x3x4. Otherwise Wither may escape by clipping through blocks.

Crafting recipes:

![Witherproof block recipe](https://i.imgur.com/Y7doJYb.png)

![Obsidian ball recipe](https://i.imgur.com/7LmRUN6.png)
